programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "Jupiter"
programme.desc: This episode examines the work of the Galileo orbiter and the Juno probe that have advanced our deeper understanding of this giant.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "Spacesuit"
programme.desc: This episode looks at the evolution of the modern spacesuit, capable of supporting life in extreme conditions.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "The Other Planets"
programme.desc: This episode reveals what we know about the solar system’s difficult to reach planets and the probes that have visited them.

programme.title: Zenith: Advances in Space Exploration S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: This episode examines the work done by the Solar and Heliospheric Observatory (SOHO); the Solar Dynamics Observatory and the Parker Solar Probe.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: We study our Sun closely, and like a Rosetta stone it can reveal the secrets of all the other stars above.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Exo Planets"
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S1 - "Edge of the Universe"
programme.desc: What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Astronauts"
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth’s surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet’s atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space As A Tax Haven"
programme.desc: For the ultra-wealthy, the best part of making money is avoiding taxes. Space could be an astronomical payday, but will all that profit slip by tax free?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Traveling So Fast Time Slows Down"
programme.sub-title: Traveling So Fast Time Slows Down
programme.desc: When we start thinking about traveling at speeds close to the speed of light, our perception of time’s passing starts to get pretty mind-bending.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Day in the life of an air show (Part 2 )"
programme.sub-title: Day in the life of an air show (Part 2 )
programme.desc: The exciting conclusion to the two-part special including an up-close look at the U.S. Navy Blue Angels.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "AOPA Summit"
programme.desc: The annual event of the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. We take you inside the aerial unit of the Los Angeles Police Department to see how the world’s largest police fleet helps to catch bad guys and Jeff talks to Red Bull Air Racer Pete McLeod, about life as a high-adrenalin, competitive flyer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Triple Tree Aerodrome"
programme.desc: A look at one of the most meticulously maintained grass runways anywhere at what we discovered to be a pure haven for lovers of aviation and the outdoors. All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-era trainer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Dream flight of a lifetime"
programme.desc: Twenty pilots attend a T33 Silverstar ground school but only one will win a chance to actually fly it. We visit the Joe Nall event, the “Oshkosh” of RC flying, and Raeleen goes flying with rock stars of the air show circuit, the Aeroshell Aerobatic Team.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Stone Age Secrets"
programme.desc: Even before the start of recorded history, ancient engineers across the World were erecting giant monuments. What was their purpose?

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "The Taj Mahal And The Golden Age Of Islam"
programme.sub-title: The Taj Mahal And The Golden Age Of Islam
programme.desc: Awe-inspiring palaces are the legacy that demonstrates the brilliance of Islamic engineers, culminating arguably the most beautiful building in the World - the Taj Mahal.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "Earliest Arenas: The Colosseum"
programme.desc: Since their earliest existence in ancient Greek and Roman civilizations, stadiums have been regarded as achitectural masterpieces and focal poins in their surrounding cities, but none more so than the Colosseum in Rome.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S2 - "How Gold Changed The World"
programme.desc: Join us as we dig deep in this episode to uncover how gold was mined and transformed into everyday objects like jewellery and currency, and even to adorn holy temples and statues.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Kapap - Amit Himelstein"
programme.desc: Amit Himelstein is the head instructor of the IKF and the leader in Kapap. His big motto? Respect everyone but fear no-one. He’s the embodiment of krav maga.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Kickboxing - Denise Kielholtz"
programme.desc: Denise Kielholtz is 6 time world champion kickboxer. Her goal? To become the world’s first female MMA world champion and will do anything to achieve this.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Lethwei - Dave le Duc"
programme.desc: Dave Leduc is the undefeated world champion in Lethwei, the most brutal sport in the world. It is fought without gloves, with elbows, headbutts and take downs.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Boxing - Ruqsana Begum"
programme.desc: Ruqsana Begum is a Muay Tai world champion who wants to become the next world champion in boxing. She’s wants to inspire Muslim women and make a difference.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Bear Attack"
programme.desc: Nick and Laura create kick-ass tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears. They use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Then try to recreate a “miracle” arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving Treestand Accidents"
programme.desc: In this exciting episode we’ll find out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how we can prevent them. Cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send our hosts, our stunt team and our special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: Military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition. Bottom line, a ton of cool shooting and science for Nick and Laura to explore!

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Lightning Strike"
programme.desc: Laura and Nick travel to a state-of-the-art Direct Effects Lightning Test Lab. With some “explosive” experiments, they’ll determine the power lightning and how it behaves? And they’ll find out how can hunters and fishermen best protect themselves?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Schapbo"
programme.desc: John Rambo’s ability to decimate enemies all by himself has created some of the most incredible weapon stunts in Hollywood history. We test the reality surrounding these iconic scenes from this blockbuster franchise.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Terry and the Minigun"
programme.desc: Can you really fire a GE Minigun handheld with ammunition held in a backpack (also seen on Captain America: Winter Soldier). Additionally, for one of our larger tests – can you actually chop down a jungle forest with a minigun?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Scoreless"
programme.desc: Using a unique method to crack a safe, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) uses a blowtorch to cut through a safe, fill it with water, and blow the door off using a small explosive device.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Terry Vs Gorn"
programme.desc: Captain James T Kirk’s battle with the Gorn alien is one of the most popular episodes from the original series. He defeats the Gorn by creating gunpowder from the base elements found on the planet.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Wooden Houses"
programme.desc: Francesca visits two companies making wooden houses. One makes flat pack homes for assembly and the other specialises in creating beautiful wooden frames.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "New York"
programme.desc: New York, New York. A city so nice, they named it twice. The cultural and financial capital of the world. Join us as we navigate the gridlocked streets and canyons created by Manhattan’s skyscrapers and marvel at the engineering wonder of the subway.

programme.title: How to Build a City S1 - "Paris"
programme.desc: The celebration of culture and conservation of heritage underpin this episode on the City of Light. Home to engineering marvels, such as the Eiffel Tower and the glass pyramid entrance to the Louvre, Paris holds a special place in our imaginations.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Lions"
programme.desc: The king of the jungle is on the brink of being a thing of the past, but for now it remains one of the last wild predators on earth.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Sharks"
programme.desc: Based on superstition and misconception, only intensive preservation efforts and increased public awareness may save them, but even then, some say it may be too late. Until that day Sharks will continue to stalk waters everywhere as one of the last remaining wild predators on earth.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Snakes"
programme.desc: With only a handful of snakes potentially dangerous to humans and most targeting rodents and pests, it seems their negative reputation today is unearned. Perhaps a product of their strange limb-less appearance, rather than their nature.

programme.title: Wild About S1 - "Raptors"
programme.desc: Many of the larger breeds of raptors are now endangered or vulnerable, particularly eagles, vultures and larger owls as they require large, specialized habitats. Though they may be soaring high now, the future doesn’t bode well for the great raptors.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Survival of the Fittest"
programme.desc: Animals adapt for survival. Crocodiles, ancient and resilient, boast slow metabolism and efficient physiology. Sharks retain successful traits over time. Whales, from land to sea, evolve with echolocation and robust anatomy, ensuring survival.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Big Cats"
programme.desc: Cheetahs race towards endangerment.Leopards thrive as opportunistic hunters.Lions reign atop the food chain. Snow leopards navigate treacherous terrain.Tigers persevere. Each big cat surviving maturity claims victory in life's relentless race.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "The Great Desert Race"
programme.desc: Deserts, harsh and arid, challenge life with scant rainfall. Desert animals adapt to conserve water, relying on food for hydration. They seek shade, burrow, or became nocturnal to survive extreme temperatures.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Herbivores"
programme.desc: Elephants, thrive on vegetation, though they're not averse to confrontation. Rhinos, resilient yet endangered, face threats from predators and humanity. Hippos, formidable and protective, safeguard their young from crocodiles and other predators.

programme.title: Animal Armoury S1 - "Spits and Stings"
programme.desc: The archer fish uses a blowgun to capture insects, while the jawfish defends itself by throwing boulders.
